name: Chika
tagline: An agentic assistant with full browser control, installed like a real app on Windows, macOS and Linux.
description: Chika reads your open tabs, navigates pages, extracts data, takes screenshots and answers questions about anything you can see in Chrome, powered by Claude, GPT-4o or other providers. Each platform gets a real installer and a real uninstaller, per-user with no admin rights, and the CLI auto-updates on launch when upstream CI is green. A one-command extension install gives it hands in the browser.
highlights: Chrome extension: read tabs, navigate, click, screenshot, watch for changes
Native installers for Windows, macOS, Debian and any Linux distro
Auto-update gated on green CI; chika doctor verifies the install
Provider and key setup in-app, changeable at any time
